domain: Domain X is tagged Table(text), TreeForm(block), AgreeOne(id,L,W,tree,A) or Run(labels,witness,trees,A); A is whether PRAG_AGREE_ALL equals '1', fixed during the call. Table maps first-column IDs to header/value zip maps: last duplicate header and last duplicate ID win, empty lines omitted but an empty ID on a nonempty row is retained. Run forms L and W maps and a last-block-wins exact sent_id->tree_form map after CRLF normalization. It emits one row per key of L in lexical order. TreeForm applies question before imperative before exclamation before declarative. AgreeOne applies P0 only to recognized original forms with non-character voice, then P1 else P2 else optional P3, then optional P4 and P5; rule predicates and numeric thresholds are those in labels/tree-form children. Missing label fields default empty for changed fields. Report n=|keys(L)|, rule counts sum per-row rule indicators, and move counts sum only form/act changes.
state: Exact ID joins do not borrow witnesses/trees from another key. Witness-only/tree-only keys add no output rows. n counts retained label-map entries, including an empty ID if present, not raw lines. P0 cannot override character voice or an unrecognized original form; P1 consumes the form after P0 and prevents P2/P3. With A=false P3/P4/P5 cannot apply, so polarity/hedge stay supplied defaults. No move entry records polarity/hedge alone; rule totals may exceed n. Question marker takes tree-form precedence over imperative and exclamation.
